eligibility.evidence: Sections 2.1, 3.4, and 3.5–4 report generative language models tested on paired cognitive-bias scenarios. The paper cites Kahneman and Tversky’s human judgment programme and reports newly constructed benchmark data.

A.title: The Alignment Footprint: Locating and Removing Cognitive Bias Circuits Written by RLHF

E.headline: The authors report causal bias-related SAE features and inference-time clamping that reduces aggregate bias on the tested benchmark, with capability costs varying by model and configuration.

G.notes: The main benchmark is author-constructed from LLM-generated scenarios, but the generation model, complete prompts, item counts by family, and query dates are not reported. The paper describes hypotheses as prospectively specified and committed before data collection, but no preregistration is cited. Code and corpus release is promised upon acceptance.
